title: Homelessness rate over time
design_reason: Preserves time ordering and explicitly flags the 2021 measurement disruption.

title: Unsheltered share over time
design_reason: Uses a comparable percentage instead of state totals with very different population sizes.

title: Homelessness composition
design_reason: A 100% composition chart avoids misleading comparisons of raw state totals.

title: Real median rent
design_reason: Uses constant dollars so the trend is not merely general inflation.

title: Real median home price
design_reason: Uses a consistent sale-price series and adjusts for inflation.

title: Home price-to-income ratio
design_reason: Combines price and income into an interpretable affordability measure.

title: Rental vacancy rate
design_reason: Direct time comparison of a central housing-market tightness measure.

title: Housing units per 1,000 residents
design_reason: Rescales the complete per-capita series to an intuitive denominator.

title: Permits per 1,000 housing units
design_reason: Normalizes permits for the very different size of the two housing stocks.

title: Housing supply growth
design_reason: Shows the expanded historical series without bridging the Census vintage boundary.

title: Homelessness and bed capacity
design_reason: Uses a common population denominator and separates states into readable panels.

title: Funding per person counted
design_reason: Normalizes funding while warning that the 2021 denominator is disrupted.

title: Real income versus home-price index
design_reason: Indexing compares growth rates without a misleading dual axis.

title: Within-state vacancy and homelessness
design_reason: Avoids treating the static California–Florida difference as the relationship.

title: Lagged permits and homelessness change
design_reason: Uses temporal ordering and a change outcome instead of a raw cross-state trend.

title: Home-price growth and homelessness change
design_reason: Compares within-state annual changes rather than raw levels.
